description: Browse or search public LinkedIn Sales and Talent community events, or fetch specific event URLs. No cookies, login, or proxy required.

communities.description: Which public LinkedIn community sites to scan (mode=search/browse).
communities.title: Communities

eventFormat.description: Filter by format (mode=search/browse). Public community events are virtual; other values legitimately return 0.
eventFormat.title: Event format

eventUrls.description: Community event URLs (scommunity.linkedin.com/events/... or tcommunity.linkedin.com/events/...) or main www.linkedin.com/events/<id> URLs (mode=byUrls).
eventUrls.title: Event URLs

includeArchivedDetails.description: For main www.linkedin.com/events URLs only (mode=byUrls): look for a public Wayback Machine guest snapshot with name, host, date text, description and venue (when archived). Archived cover images are omitted because their signed CDN URLs are expired.
includeArchivedDetails.title: Include archived details for main event URLs

includeDescriptions.description: Add the full event description text. Schedules, timezones, images, registration links and categories are always fetched.
includeDescriptions.title: Include descriptions

language.description: Keep events whose source label is this language (mode=search/browse). Events labelled with a topic instead of a language are omitted when this filter is set.
language.title: Event language

maxEvents.description: Hard cap on emitted records. A direct event URL always returns its one event.
maxEvents.title: Max events

searchQuery.description: Keyword filter over event titles (mode=search). Leave empty to return every event. Matching is case- and accent-insensitive.
searchQuery.title: Search query

title: LinkedIn Community Events Scraper Input
